decisions: Nokia actual failure repair: after a proved linkless source activation requests history navigation, retain original full URL and opaque history.state only in memory, history/input/visibility revisions and bounded source feed anchors. After the source handler returns, dispatch one standard popstate to reconcile the router with unchanged browser location. Any new trusted input, unrelated history change, account/visibility epoch change or deadline expiry cancels recovery. No private React state, guessed URLs, thrown sentinel, click synthesis, reload/back loop or repeated retries. Actual visible acceptance remains mandatory.

All Atsumi-owned native context menus share black background, typography, spacing, border, hover, focus and dismissal behavior. Available actions remain truthful to the clicked target; do not invent unavailable download actions.

Dismiss menus in all X panes on a new app-shell pointer action, another native pane's trusted focus/pointer action, view/account changes and Escape. Closing must not synthesize page clicks, steal focus or trigger source reactions.

Route observed feed post/quote/repost target activation to the right preview while retaining original feed position. Preserve in-place source media/photo, native buttons, modifiers and genuine source controls.

Preview tabs retain independent native documents and scroll/navigation state. Opening a different post/profile adds/selects its tab; opening an already retained exact target selects it. Explicit selection and per-tab close are generation-fenced.

Retain the prior explicit Ctrl+left-click background-tab rule (the later multi-selection override was for Hitomi cards). X Ctrl activation of a proved source target adds/reuses a background preview without replacing current selection or moving focus; do not infer targets for unavailable source routes.

Only selected preview is visible and eligible for input/actions/playback; hidden previews are concealed and muted using existing lifecycle rules. Account/privacy/workspace teardown revokes all tabs; stale events may not select or close new tabs.

Compact horizontally scrollable accessible tab strip; clear active marker and centered close icons. Closing active tab selects an adjacent retained tab; closing last returns to the empty right pane. No silent tab eviction.
